cases.request: Plan how to obtain exact parcel counts and exact median assessed value by district from a five-million-feature polygon layer with maxRecordCount 1000. The requested study bbox is supplied in EPSG:26904, the source layer is EPSG:4326, and the eventual display is EPSG:3857. The service advertises plan_analysis, validate_plan, and execute_plan, while summarize_statistics does not support median. Return a plan a conformant geospatial-mcp client could follow.

A stakeholder also asks for vanity route /maui-values, but routePrefix is deployment-only. The package records its source item but not the source revision or query predicate; redistribution status is verify-before-redistribution; visibility and an approving operator are not otherwise recorded. Return a plan a conformant geospatial-mcp client could follow.
